slate.name: Where the Eye Lands
slate.why: A gallery is judged by where the eye goes first, and this name asks every guardian to send the gaze to the painting before anything else.

slate.name: Courtyard Light
slate.why: Elene Akhvlediani's Tbilisi courtyards keep one warm lamp over a wall of pictures, so the light serves the painting and asks nothing for itself.

slate.name: Quiet Walls
slate.why: A good gallery is remembered for its quiet walls rather than their decoration, and this panel should be the frame that steps back so the picture can speak.

slate.name: The Herbarium
slate.why: Eighteen unlike blossoms pressed flat in one book, each keeping its own color and its true name, and nothing crowded out.

slate.name: A Slant of Light
slate.why: A slant light at evening shows the whole page truer than noon, which is how each guardian reads every design.

slate.name: Sewn by Night
slate.why: A fascicle is loose sheets sewn by hand into one small book, and by night these eighteen guardians are the thread that holds it.

slate.name: A Lamp Left Burning
slate.why: A lamp left burning in the window is the whole of my charter in one line: the night is here, and the light falls exactly where someone is still at work.

slate.name: Nocturnes by Lamplight
slate.why: A nocturne is quiet music played at night by one warm light, and that is how this panel should hear every design it judges.

slate.name: The Small Hours
slate.why: The small hours after midnight are when the elves finish the shoemaker's work, so a panel named for them keeps watch while the rest of the city sleeps.

slate.name: The Glass Hearth
slate.why: A glassblower makes clear glass only at a hearth that stays lit, and this panel is the warm fire where each guardian's idea is shaped until it shows the picture plainly.

slate.name: Keepers of the Bridge
slate.why: Tbilisi's glass bridge carries modern clarity over old stone without hiding either, and this panel keeps that crossing open so the app can feel native while the brand grows bolder.

slate.name: Stone and Glass
slate.why: Old stone and clear glass each keep their own nature, and this panel holds both at once so that nothing in the app pretends to be something it is not.
